## Why visit

The strongest anchor for a Chorlton beer excursion. Formerly the Marble Beer House, it now combines Marble with independent guests in a compact, conversational setting. Its repeated local CAMRA recognition, including the documented 2026 branch award, adds a useful quality signal without replacing the practical reason to visit: a focused changing beer range in a neighbourhood pub. Pair it with Chorlton Tap and Fell for a coherent suburban circuit instead of scattering the day across unrelated outer-city venues.

## Beer

Cask from Marble and guests; CAMRA notes a tendency towards pale beers below 5% rather than promising a broad dark-beer range. CAMRA lists Marble Manchester Bitter and Pint as regulars; changing casks have included Abbeydale, Blackjack and RedWillow. This is not a November stock promise.

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** CAMRA explicitly flags real cider but does not specify a fixed producer; ask about bottles and the current selection.

## Plan the visit

Not the Marble Arch and no longer branded Marble Beer House. Monday quiz can affect seating; check opening and any events before travelling.

**Getting there:** Chorlton tram stop, then walk; combine with Chorlton Tap and Fell Chorlton.
